description.en: AI-assisted workspace for discovering, previewing, and organizing shadcn components.
description.zh: 聚合、实时预览与智能编排全网 shadcn 优质组件的 AI 工作台。

content.en: Uiuno is an AI-powered visual workspace designed to streamline how developers discover, assemble, and organize components across the distributed shadcn ecosystem. With semantic component search, real-time code remixing, and registry management, Uiuno boosts UI development velocity.
content.zh: Uiuno 是一款专为 shadcn 生态开发者设计的 AI 辅助可视化组件工作台。它打破了各独立 Registry 间的信息孤岛，提供基于语义的智能组件发现、在线实时代码微调混音与可视化排版编排，极大提升了从查找组件到工程落地的敏捷度。
